recommendation: Fix exact-head CI, adopt agent-panel review, prepare revision-pinned hosted execution specifications, and keep every unobserved gate fail-closed.

gates.recommended_option: Run the existing recovery bundle in an ephemeral revision-pinned runner and capture signed logs, timestamps and restored hashes.
gates.contingency: Use GitHub Actions first; use a budget-capped Hugging Face cpu-basic Job only if Actions cannot represent the failure-domain exercise.
gates.non_claim: A local or panel rehearsal is not hosted recovery evidence.

gates.recommended_option: Start digest-chained scheduled observations only after the candidate revision and SLO contract are frozen.
gates.contingency: A material candidate or instrumentation change resets the relevant clock; retain earlier observations as rehearsal evidence.
gates.non_claim: Generated timestamps cannot substitute for elapsed time.

gates.recommended_option: Publish a revision-pinned public workload manifest, correctness oracle and tiered resource envelope before scaling execution.
gates.contingency: If national public inputs remain unavailable, report regional/synthetic ceilings and prohibit national-scale claims.
gates.non_claim: Hardware capacity or a runnable job specification is not a measured national result.

gates.recommended_option: Use agent panels for all review and retain operator/user roles only as execution and usability evidence producers.
gates.contingency: Remain at technical preview if actual external workflow evidence is absent.
gates.non_claim: Agent panels do not attest to an external participant's experience.

gates.recommended_option: Run parallel agent lenses and require an orchestrator synthesis for each track qualification packet.
gates.contingency: Keep the track open when panel findings or evidence links are unresolved.
gates.non_claim: Panel qualification does not grant promotion authority.

gates.recommended_option: Assemble a digest-bound options paper and require the accountable authority to record promotion, deferral or rejection.
gates.contingency: No beta, RC or stable promotion without the decision record.
gates.non_claim: A developer or agent recommendation is not an accountable release decision.

gates.recommended_option: Reconcile issues to content-bound evidence in dependency order; close only after validation and panel disposition.
gates.contingency: Defer out-of-scope work explicitly without changing maturity or release claims.
gates.non_claim: An issue label, generated roadmap or plan checkbox is not implementation evidence.

library_decision.decision: Do not add runtime dependencies now. Use the installed Hugging Face CLI for revision-pinned transfer and job preparation; add a library only when a tested in-process integration is required.
library_decision.rationale: No candidate library closes an evidence gate by itself, and dependency growth increases audit and supply-chain work.
